title: MZ this.drawActorPicture is not a function issue

posts.author: Muichiro_Tokito
posts.body: Hey everyone! So I recently saw MZ was on sale and decided to do a major switch over to RPG MAKER MZ. I managed to transfer almost everything successfully and also bought Visustella's Plugins (which I believe are the same as Yanfly's, just for MZ instead)! I'm slowly going through each plugin to ensure they work, and so far, everything has been good. When I get errors, I am able to find the issue, but I cannot wrap my head around this error. It's ONLY when I open the Skill Menu for the actors that this error pops up. I'm not sure what the issue could be, and I would be happy if someone could help me out! I feel like this is the only error I've encountered so far, and it's with the Main Menu; that's really it. (Main Menu, as in when loading the game and opening the menu screen to display all the party members, etc.) Overall, my journey with MZ has been nice! Loving everything it has to offer, besides all this error stuff. Anyways, any help is appreciated, and thank you to anyone who pitches in!
